title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
blurb: Fine-tuned large models by freezing the pretrained weights and training a low-rank update, cutting trainable parameters by orders of magnitude with no added inference latency.
intro: A frozen weight $W_0$ gets a trainable update $\frac{\alpha}{r}AB$ with $A$ random and $B$ zero, so training starts exactly at the pretrained model. Only the thin factors receive gradients and optimiser state, and after training the update can be merged into $W_0$. The steps build a linear layer, low-rank approximation and the SVD that underlies it; the capstone fine-tunes adapters on a frozen layer and merges them.
